interpretation: For unit response obligations whose legal response turns form contiguous intervals, the interval-Hall inequalities matched explicit injective response-slot matching on every exhaustively generated family through four slots and up to n+1 obligations.
The ordinary Connect Four double-threat shape is the smallest capacity defect: two mandatory responses constrained to one defender turn.
If an interval of defender turns is already tight, adding any additional repair obligation whose complete admissible window lies inside that interval makes the response schedule impossible.
This qualifies temporal response-slot compatibility only. It does not establish which obligations a Connect Four attacker can force, nor does it replace cell/resource/order guards owned by CPC/NDC.
anti_leakage: No perfect-play terminal-line classification, solved-state table, or opening-book witness was used.
